text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick thread: clarifying the post-calibration appeals path and how payroll timing affects retro changes. Keeping short.
Devon (Eng): Is there a hard cutoff for changes that affect comp? We had someone ask if a calibration shift can change their bonus this cycle.
Maya (People Ops): Yes — payroll cutoff is Fri 05/03 17:00 PT. Any rating changes that affect pay after that go into a retro bucket and require VP + Compensation Ops approval. They'll hit the next payroll run.
Rina (HRBP): What about small corrections (typo in a manager note) vs substantive rating changes? Different handling?
Maya (People Ops): Typos can be fixed via a ticket and will be updated in records but won't change payroll. Substantive rating edits need the appeals flow (form + evidence + manager signoff).
Omar (Product): Can an employee initiate an appeal or is it manager-only?
Maya (People Ops): Employee can request an appeal but must go through manager first. Appeal steps: manager reviews -> if disagreement persists, escalate to HRBP -> panel (HRBP + 2 peer managers + Compensation Ops) for final determination.
Lindsey (Finance): Note: any changes that alter comp will need a cost estimate attached. Please include FTE and delta in USD in the appeal form.
hr-bot: Appeal form created: https://redwood.company/hr/appeals. Auto ticket AP-2026-995.
Maya (People Ops): Minimal appeal template (paste into form):
```
Employee: name
Current rating: X
Requested change: Y
Manager signoff: yes/no (attach note)
Evidence: 1-3 bullets (links)
Payroll impact estimate: $____
Why urgent: (if after payroll cutoff)
```
Devon (Eng): If an appeal is submitted after payroll cutoff and approved, will the employee see money retroactively?
Maya (People Ops): Yes if approved. Retro pay is processed the following payroll cycle and labeled as "retro adjustment". Expect 1 payroll cycle delay minimum.
Rina (HRBP): For global hires, please note tax withholdings may differ; comp ops will route to local payroll teams. Flag country on the form.
Maya (People Ops): Final note: appeals for promotion-level changes also require calibration panel re-review and may trigger market comp review. Reach out to me for urgent cases.
Omar (Product): Thanks 44d sharing with my team leads now.
Maya (People Ops): I'll post a one-pager and the appeal link in the handbook and send a short invite for a 20-min Q&A tomorrow.
hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: appeals window for this cycle closes 05/10 23:59 PT.
